texts.ui-add-to-empty: No playlists yet: create one below.
texts.ui-backups-intro: Each backup holds both of the USB's databases: legacy (PDB) and new (eDB).
texts.ui-convert-intro: Makes another file of each selected lossless track, for players that can't read FLAC or ALAC. It is still the same track: no new library row, and cues and edits stay on the track.
texts.ui-convert-remove-tooltip: Delete the selected tracks' transcode files
texts.ui-drive-name-conflict: This drive carries the name “{name}”, but it isn't the drive this computer knows by that name — most likely it's a copy of it. Give this one a name of its own so the two don't share backups.
texts.ui-drive-name-intro: Give this USB a name so backups and local caching can reliably follow it, even on a different computer. If this is a real USB drive with a volume label, it's pre-filled below — edit it or replace it with your own. Each drive needs its own name, even when several have the same volume label.
texts.ui-drive-name-rename-note: The drive's backups and local cache stay with it under the new name.
texts.ui-event-log-button-linked-details: Event Log, has details for the USB report
texts.ui-event-log-open-file-failed: Could not open the log file: {error}
texts.ui-event-log-open-file-tooltip: Open this session's full log in a text viewer -- the list here keeps only the newest entries
texts.ui-group-edit-intro: Only the fields you change are written; the rest stay as they are on each track. An empty field clears it.
texts.ui-group-edit-release-date-tooltip: YYYY-MM-DD, or just YYYY-MM or YYYY: export completes a month or year
texts.ui-group-edit-waiting-for-usb-job: Waiting for the running USB job to finish before saving...
texts.ui-help-donate-text: Support options are maintained on chiph.art so payment links can stay current.
texts.ui-help-step-analyze-text: Click "Analyze Library" to check your folders for changes and analyze their tracks.
texts.ui-help-step-export-text: Open your playlist and click "Export to USB" to write it to your drive.
texts.ui-help-step-folders-text: Click "+ Add Folder" in Library to add your music directories.
texts.ui-help-step-playlist-text: Click "+ New" in the sidebar to create a playlist, then add tracks from Library or USB.
texts.ui-help-step-usb-text: Go to USB and select your External library USB drive.
texts.ui-library-chip-not-imported-mixxx-toolt: Not imported yet: click ↻ to import from Mixxx
texts.ui-library-chip-not-imported-rekordbox-t: Not imported yet: click ↻ to import from rekordbox
texts.ui-library-empty-heading: Add a music folder to get started
texts.ui-library-folder-missing-tooltip: Source folder missing. Click to relocate.
texts.ui-library-search-placeholder: Search title, artist, album, genre, year
texts.ui-playback-not-found: Cannot play: track not found in Library or selected USB.
texts.ui-playlist-add-none-resolved: No imported track IDs found to add
texts.ui-playlist-add-select-first: Select at least one track to add
texts.ui-playlist-empty-heading: Browse Library or USB to add tracks
texts.ui-playlist-export-space-tooltip: The size to copy includes the tracks' analysis files and artwork, so it can be larger than the audio size in the title
texts.ui-playlist-format-warning-tooltip: Follows the USB's Audio formats (USB view). Only lossless tracks can be converted
texts.ui-playlist-import-force-note: Replaces the BPM, key and cues of the playlists' tracks, including your own edits.
texts.ui-playlist-import-intro: Each is imported as a new playlist. Tracks not yet in the library are imported with it.
texts.ui-playlist-none-active: Create and activate a playlist first
texts.ui-playlist-track-order-still-loading: Track order not saved: the list was still loading. Try again.
texts.ui-rating-tooltip: Click a star to rate; click the same star again to clear
texts.ui-selection-bar-add-to-tooltip: Pick one or more playlists to add the selected tracks to
texts.ui-selection-bar-convert-tooltip: Make AIFF, WAV or MP3 files of the selected lossless tracks for players that can't read FLAC or ALAC, or remove them
texts.ui-selection-bar-edit-tooltip: Edit genre, release date and rating of the selected tracks
texts.ui-selection-bar-hint-library: Select tracks to add, reanalyze, convert or edit them
texts.ui-selection-bar-hint-playlist: Select tracks to add, remove, reanalyze, convert or edit them
texts.ui-selection-bar-hint-usb: Select tracks to add to a playlist or edit them
texts.ui-selection-bar-reanalyze-tooltip: Reset waveform, BPM, key and first beat of the selected tracks to a fresh analysis, replacing imported or edited values (cues are kept)
texts.ui-selection-bar-remove-tooltip: Remove the selected tracks from this playlist (they stay in the library)
texts.ui-settings-backup-before-export: Back up PDB and eDB before export
texts.ui-settings-backup-before-export-hint: Before each export, copies the PDB and eDB into a timestamped backups folder alongside the originals.
texts.ui-settings-backups-to-keep-hint: The newest backup always stays on the USB; older ones are archived on this computer up to this count, then pruned.
texts.ui-settings-engine-library-disabled: Engine DJ library on export: disabled
texts.ui-settings-engine-library-enabled: Engine DJ library on export: enabled
texts.ui-settings-engine-library-hint: Whenever this app changes a USB, rebuilds the library Denon Prime and Numark Mixstream players read, so they use its beat grids, cues and playlists without importing and analyzing again. Play history is kept; changes made on the player itself (cues, loops, playlists) are replaced.
texts.ui-settings-sync-mode-additive-hint: Adds missing tracks to same-name USB playlists, but keeps existing USB tracks.
texts.ui-settings-sync-mode-mirror-hint: Same-name playlists on USB are rewritten to exactly match this app playlist (old tracks removed).
texts.ui-settings-transcode-folder-hint: Where Convert… saves the AIFF, WAV and MP3 files it makes. Keep it outside your music folders, so other music apps don't list the files twice. A new folder only applies to new files.
texts.ui-sidebar-import-playlist-tooltip: Import playlists from rekordbox or Mixxx
texts.ui-sidebar-resizer-tooltip: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
texts.ui-track-columns-blocked-order-edit: Save or cancel the order edit first to change the columns
texts.ui-track-columns-intro: Tick the columns to show and drag them into order. Every track list uses this layout.
texts.ui-track-detail-add-memory-cue-tooltip: Add a memory cue at the playhead (M)
texts.ui-track-detail-analyze-first: Analyze this track first to edit its cues.
texts.ui-track-detail-bpm-double-tooltip: Double the BPM (analysis caught half tempo)
texts.ui-track-detail-bpm-half-tooltip: Halve the BPM (analysis caught double tempo)
texts.ui-track-detail-connect-usb-first: Connect the USB this track is on before editing its cues.
texts.ui-track-detail-follow-grid-tooltip: Cues follow grid: changing BPM or the first beat moves every cue so it stays on its beat. Off, cues keep their place in the audio, as in rekordbox
texts.ui-track-detail-genre-tooltip: Genre: type one or pick one the library already has
texts.ui-track-detail-grid-level-tooltip: How strongly the beat grid shows over the waveform
texts.ui-track-detail-hint-cue-markers-free: places freely · click to play from the cue ·
texts.ui-track-detail-hint-tooltip: Waveform: click to move the playhead, drag the playhead to listen, double-click to add a cue, scroll to zoom, drag to pan. Cue markers: drag to move, click to play from the cue. With Q on, cues snap to beats; hold Shift to place freely. Keys: Space play/pause · C add cue · M add memory cue · 1–8 jump to cue · ←/→ move the selected cue a beat (Shift: 10 ms) · Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo.
texts.ui-track-detail-hint-waveform-text: click to move the playhead · drag the playhead to listen · double-click to add a cue · scroll to zoom · drag to pan
texts.ui-track-detail-metronome-mix-tooltip: Metronome mix: left favours the music, right the clicks; in the middle both play at full level
texts.ui-track-detail-metronome-tooltip: Metronome: click on every beat while playing, to hear whether the grid lines up
texts.ui-track-detail-overview-aria-label: Whole track: click or drag to move the view
texts.ui-track-detail-quantize-tooltip: Quantize: new and dragged cues snap to the nearest beat (hold Shift to place freely)
texts.ui-track-detail-release-date-tooltip: Release date: YYYY-MM-DD, or just YYYY-MM or YYYY (export completes a month or year); empty for none
texts.ui-track-detail-start-first-beat-tooltip: Adds a ▶ memory cue (no hot cue) on the first beat, so the CDJ loads there instead of on cue A
texts.ui-track-detail-start-first-cue-tooltip: The CDJ loads on its first cue: cue A, or a memory cue before it
texts.ui-track-detail-start-marker-tooltip: The CDJ loads on the ▶ start marker you placed; drag it on the waveform to move it
texts.ui-track-detail-start-note: No cue points yet: the CDJ starts at the first audio
texts.ui-track-detail-waiting-for-usb-job: Waiting for the running USB job to finish before saving cues...
texts.ui-track-row-add-no-playlist-tooltip: Create and activate a playlist first, then add tracks to it.
texts.ui-track-row-analyze-tooltip: Add the missing waveform, BPM, key and first beat; a BPM or key you edited or imported is kept
texts.ui-track-row-reanalyze-tooltip: Reset waveform, BPM, key and first beat to a fresh analysis, replacing imported or edited values (cues are kept)
texts.ui-tracklist-export-estimated-note: Times are estimated by summing track lengths in play order — CDJs do not record per-track playback times in the USB.
texts.ui-update-busy: Finish the running job before updating.
texts.ui-usb-backups-tooltip: List, restore and delete backups of this USB's databases
texts.ui-usb-drag-to-set-tooltip: Drag to set the order of preference
texts.ui-usb-empty-heading: Connect a USB drive to browse and export
texts.ui-usb-export-failed: Export failed: {error}. See Event Log for details.
texts.ui-usb-parity-intro: Checks that older and newer Pioneer players see the same playlists and tracks on this USB.
texts.ui-usb-parity-report-tooltip: Check that the USB's legacy (PDB) and new (eDB) databases agree
texts.ui-usb-playlists-drag-search-active: Clear the search to drag tracks
texts.ui-usb-playlists-edit-order-busy: Wait for the running USB job to finish
texts.ui-usb-playlists-edit-order-tooltip: Change the order of the playlists and of the tracks in them; nothing is written until Save order
texts.ui-usb-playlists-leave-message: The new order of this USB's playlists isn't saved yet.
texts.ui-usb-playlists-order-edit-blocks-jobs: Save or cancel the order edit first
texts.ui-usb-select-usb-folder-busy-title: Please wait for the current USB operation to finish
texts.ui-usb-switch-busy: Please wait for the current USB operation to finish before switching drives
